page.layout: One column of text on a single printed page. Running head at top with page number at top right. Below the text: signature at lower left and catchword at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Ratio v. Ab exemplis laudatis: Obstetricum in Ægypto mendacio officioso servantium infantes, Exod. 1. 20. Michalis servantis maritum Davidem: 1. Sam. 19. 17. Jehu tollentis Baalitas, 2. Reg. 10. 18.
Habeat translationem.Si quid peccatum sit, Jo-suam potius peccasse negligentiâ inquisitionis.
Et adversativam: Te tamen paratum esse au-dire amici rationes, si diversum sentiat.
main_text.head: Pars negans.
Refutatur defensio doli Gibeonitarum.
main_text.p: EXordium breve sumatur à thesi: Multa pec-cata videri hominibus rectè facta.
Applicetur ad hypothesin de dolo Gibeonitarum: Ideo excusari eum à nonnullis, quia ingeniose inventus sit, & utiliter cesserit.
Propositio per adversat. Te vero oftensurum, quòd excusari non possit.
Ratio 1. Quia lex Dei simpliciter vetet, fal-sum dicere voluntate fallendi: Non dices falsum testimonium, &c. Non eris testis mendax, &c.
Minor confirmetur ex historiæ circumstantiis: Dicunt, quæ sciunt non esse vera: simulant falsa, ut fallant Josuam.
Ratio II. Quia turpe & injustum sit, in pactis & conventis mendacem esse.

page.notes: The numeral after "Ratio" in the last paragraph is printed as two strokes that could be read as "11" or "II"; I have written "II". The sign before "Applicetur" is a printed mark I could not identify and have left out. The large initial E is joined to the italic "Xordium" as printed. The page number is printed as "89".
